name: p300
note: P300 speller (BNCI2014_009), 10 subjects, 16 centro-parietal electrodes, 1-24 Hz over 0-0.8 s post-stimulus. NOT motor imagery: a phase-locked evoked deflection rather than band-power desynchronisation, which is why the contract differs -- the motor-imagery 4 Hz high-pass would remove most of the P300 and its 0.5 s onset begins after the peak. Classes are ~1:5 NonTarget:Target, so THE HEADLINE SCORE IS BALANCED ACCURACY and AUC: a constant NonTarget predictor scores ~83% plain accuracy while decoding nothing. This tests whether the encoder's inductive biases, tuned entirely on sensorimotor band-power, transfer to an evoked-response paradigm.
